Overview

Mikkeli is a city in South Savo with a population of 54,000. A lakeside city in the Savo region, known for its cathedral, WWII headquarters museum, and lake cruises. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
